newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo Jan construction works worth 114 mln dinars.
newsitem.headline: Yugo Jan construction works worth 114 mln dinars.

text.p: The value of completed construction works in Yugoslavia in January rose to 113.667 million dinars from 88.399 million in the same month 1996, the Federal Statistics Office reported.
The data covers major construction companies accounting for around 80 percent of total annual value of construction works.
The number of workers employed at construction sites dropped by five percent to 56,435 from last January's 59,507. These figures exclude engineers and technicians.
The total number of hours put in by the workers dropped 11 percent to 5.63 million from 6.32 million in January 1996.

The value of concluded building contracts stood at 805.164 million dinars at the end of January. The data refer to construction works to be carried out during the year, regardless of when the orders were made.
